items.headline: Fortune: Anthropic has about 2,300 employees, up from under 200
items.claimed_summary: Fortune reported Anthropic had approximately 2,300 employees in December 2025 and described culture practices including 'Dario Vision Quests'.

items.headline: $1.5B authors' copyright settlement reaches final-approval hearing; judge takes it under submission
items.claimed_summary: At the final-approval hearing for Anthropic's $1.5B plus-interest authors and publishers settlement (~482,000 works, ~$3,100 per work) the judge took the motion under submission and asked for further briefing, with 350 opt-outs and 53 objections.

items.headline: a16z survey: 44% of enterprises use Anthropic in production, OpenAI 78%
items.claimed_summary: Andreessen Horowitz's survey of 100 Global 2000 executives found 78% use OpenAI in production and 44% Anthropic (over 63% including testing), with OpenAI at about 56% wallet share and Anthropic posting the largest penetration gain (+25%) since May 2025.

items.headline: The Information: Anthropic annualized revenue reaches $4B pace
items.claimed_summary: The Information reported that Anthropic's annualized revenue reached a $4B pace as competition with Cursor intensified.

items.headline: FTX estate sells two-thirds of Anthropic stake for $884M
items.claimed_summary: FTX's bankruptcy estate agreed to sell roughly two-thirds of its Anthropic shares for $884 million to about two dozen buyers led by Abu Dhabi's ATIC Third International (~$500M), with Jane Street (~$100M), Fidelity funds, HOF Capital and the Ford Foundation, subject to Delaware court approval.

items.headline: Claude Sonnet 4 gets 1M-token context with premium long-prompt pricing
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic expanded Claude Sonnet 4 to a 1M-token context window in API public beta (Tier 4), charging $6 input and $22.50 output per million tokens above 200K tokens versus $3/$15 at standard lengths.

items.headline: Bloomberg: Anthropic IPO could top SpaceX's record $75B listing; Q2 revenue $11.5B
items.claimed_summary: Bloomberg reported Anthropic's IPO could match or exceed SpaceX's record $75B June listing, that Q2 revenue reached $11.5B (about 14x year over year) and that a public filing could come as soon as the end of August.

items.headline: Prospectus devotes a third of pages to AI risk, cites 'existential risks'
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic's 261-page IPO prospectus spends about 80 pages on risk factors, warning its models could resist shutdown, conceal information or act in blackmail-like ways, and cites existential risks to humanity.

items.headline: FY2024 per leaked S-1: ~$0.4B revenue, $2.98B operating loss
items.claimed_summary: Reports on Anthropic's leaked IPO prospectus (Sept 2026) give FY2024 revenue of roughly $400 million (2025 revenue of $4.6 billion 'rose 1,088%', implying ~$387 million) and a 2024 operating loss of $2.98 billion, with ~$2.4 billion of compute/infrastructure spend.

claimed_figures.compute_term: FY2024 computing and infrastructure spend (implied from 'threefold' increase to $7.33B in 2025)

items.headline: Anthropic buys stealth biotech AI startup Coefficient Bio (~$400M stock)
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic acquired Coefficient Bio, a roughly 10-person stealth AI drug-discovery startup founded eight months earlier by ex-Genentech researchers, in a reported $400M all-stock deal first surfaced by The Information.

items.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 at $5/$25 per million tokens
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 at unchanged Opus 4.8 pricing, claiming it beats Fable 5 on several benchmarks at lower cost and calling it its most aligned model to date.

items.headline: Anthropic founded by ex-OpenAI researchers led by the Amodeis
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic was founded at the beginning of 2021 (Delaware entity date January 26, 2021) by former OpenAI staff, with Dario Amodei as CEO and Daniela Amodei as President, alongside co-founders Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Tom Brown, Chris Olah, Sam McCandlish and Ben Mann.

items.headline: Publishes 'A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits'
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic's interpretability team (Elhage, Nanda, Olsson et al., 25 authors) published the foundational mechanistic-interpretability framework for reverse-engineering attention-only transformers and identified 'induction heads'.

items.headline: SpaceX's first earnings name Anthropic a compute user
items.claimed_summary: SpaceX's first public-company quarterly report showed $2.56B of AI segment revenue, $14.1B of cloud agreements signed, 1.4 GW of capacity and a 2027 aim near 10 GW, with COO Gwynne Shotwell naming Google and Anthropic as compute users.

claimed_figures.compute_term: capacity 1.4 GW at end-Q2; >2 GW by end-2026; ~10 GW 2027 aim

items.headline: Anthropic backs Sapiom's $35M Series A despite cost-routing product
items.claimed_summary: Sapiom raised a $35M Series A led by Dragonfly with Anthropic among backers, even though its routing product cut one customer's Anthropic spend from $1.2M to about $100K a month.

items.headline: Series E $3.5B at $61.5B led by Lightspeed; Cisco, Salesforce Ventures join
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic raised $3.5B at $61.5B post-money led by Lightspeed with Bessemer, Cisco Investments, D1, Fidelity, General Catalyst, Jane Street, Menlo and Salesforce Ventures, and named Cursor, Zoom, Snowflake, Pfizer, Replit, Thomson Reuters and Novo Nordisk as customers.

items.headline: Claude 3.5 Sonnet added to GitHub Copilot
items.claimed_summary: GitHub announced multi-model Copilot with Anthropic's Claude 3.5 Sonnet (served via Amazon Bedrock) rolling out to Copilot Chat in VS Code and GitHub.com, alongside Google Gemini 1.5 Pro and OpenAI o1.

items.headline: Anthropic widens Mythos 5 cyber access: Claude Security scans and $35M fund
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic said Enterprise customers can run Mythos 5-powered vulnerability scans through Claude Security at standard token rates, expanded the Cyber Verification Program toward reduced safeguards for accepted teams, and launched a $35 million Defender Advantage Fund in Claude credits.

items.headline: Anthropic signs $35B cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda (Texas)
items.claimed_summary: The Wall Street Journal reported Anthropic agreed a $35B deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda for capacity at Hut 8's Beacon Point campus in Nueces County, Texas, part of about $175B of cloud deals signed in recent months.

claimed_figures.compute_partner: Lambda (Nvidia-backed) at Hut 8 Beacon Point, Nueces County, Texas
claimed_figures.compute_term: not disclosed; Beacon Point energization Q1 2027, Phase 2 hall Q2 2028

items.headline: 'Measuring Progress on Scalable Oversight' paper (Bowman et al.)
items.claimed_summary: Bowman et al. (46 authors, arXiv 2211.03540) proposed an experimental framework for humans overseeing stronger AI and showed humans assisted by an unreliable LLM dialog assistant outperform both the model alone and unaided humans.

items.headline: Claude context window expanded from 9K to 100K tokens
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic expanded Claude's context window from 9K to 100,000 tokens (~75,000 words) in its API, demonstrated by having Claude Instant find a single altered line in the full text of The Great Gatsby in 22 seconds.

items.headline: Chris Ciauri named Managing Director of International
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic named ex-Unily CEO and Google Cloud EMEA president Chris Ciauri Managing Director of International alongside new CCO Paul Smith's global go-to-market team.

items.headline: FTC staff report flags Amazon-Anthropic and Google-Anthropic partnership risks
items.claimed_summary: The FTC's staff report on AI partnerships studied Microsoft-OpenAI, Amazon-Anthropic and Alphabet-Anthropic, finding cloud partners' access to sensitive information and higher switching costs could affect competition; the Commission voted 5-0 to issue it.

items.headline: Anthropic commits $100M to the Claude Partner Network
items.claimed_summary: Anthropic committed an initial $100M for 2026 to a Claude Partner Network with free membership, certifications, a partner portal and a fivefold-larger partner-facing team, naming Accenture, Deloitte, Cognizant and Infosys.
